note: Everything in this file is derived from wrangler.jsonc/src/index.js in THIS repo checkout, verifiable by any future reader by re-running the export script. Fields the repo cannot itself verify (real Cloudflare Dashboard state) are explicitly marked unverified, never guessed.

cron.note: UTC in Cloudflare config. V1.9.8: Cloudflare's own PBS 30-minute fetch is RETIRED (src/pbs/pbsConfig.js#PBS_30_MIN_POLLING_ENABLED=false) — PBS's production main line is now the Windows push ingress (POST /internal/pbs-debug-push), not this Cron tick; the code path is preserved, not deleted, for rollback. TDX remains gated inside the scheduled handler to every 2nd tick (minute 00/20/40) and 08:00-21:59:59 Asia/Taipei only (src/traffic/tdxSchedule.js) — unaffected by the PBS retirement. Declared schedule from wrangler.jsonc -- verified from repo; the REAL Cloudflare Cron Trigger config is dashboard-only and not verifiable from here.

ai.note: V1.9.9 Phase 3B: declared in wrangler.jsonc for @cf/zai-org/glm-4.7-flash driver-impact decisions (src/pbs/aiDecisionEngine.js). Declaring this binding does NOT activate AI decisions -- the real gate is the code-level kill switch src/pbs/aiConfig.js#PBS_AI_DECISION_ENABLED (default false). GPT Work confirmed the Dashboard-side binding is ACTIVE. V1.9.9 Phase 3D hotfix: resolvePbsAiDecisionEnabled() previously only accepted a real boolean; Cloudflare Dashboard/CLI Variables inject this kind of runtime flag as a STRING, so a Dashboard value of "true" silently stayed disabled. Fixed to also accept the string forms 'true'/'false' (case-insensitive, trimmed), still failing safe to false for anything else. AI_DECISION currently DISABLED_PENDING_GPT_WORK_RETRY -- GPT Work's earlier rollback (PBS_AI_DECISION_ENABLED=FALSE) is still in effect; not yet independently confirmed from this repo checkout whether a retry has occurred.

bindings.varsNote: These are the runtime flags that decide what Production actually does, so they belong in the manifest rather than only in wrangler.jsonc. TRAFFIC_SOURCE_MODE=PBS_ONLY stops every TDX API call; LINE_PUSH_POLICY=MAJOR_ACCIDENT_ONLY narrows proactive LINE push to accidents. Both are substituted from wrangler.jsonc by the export script, never hardcoded here.
bindings.secretsNote: Names only -- never values. Presence-only verifiable via GET /admin/deployment-status; correctness of any value is never verifiable from code.

public.note: Shared Traffic Feed consumer read path

V1.9.8: Windows PBS Local Monitor -> formal Production ingress (src/pbs/debugPush.js) — an accepted NEW/UPDATED event reaches the canonical Business Pipeline (runLineBroadcast/Shared Feed); CLEARED is acknowledged but never broadcast; duplicates are idempotent via TRAFFIC_KV under debug:pbs-push-idempotency:v1:*. V1.9.9 Phase 3B: when the code-level kill switch PBS_AI_DECISION_ENABLED is true (Production default: false), this same endpoint instead routes the event through resolveAiDecision() (src/pbs/aiDecisionEngine.js) and, on a validated notify:true verdict, runAiApprovedPbsBroadcast() (src/traffic/aiApprovedPbsBroadcast.js) — mutually exclusive with the legacy runLineBroadcast() call for that same event, never both.
opaque 128-bit id, 15-min TTL enforced in code
